title: bonsai.state/1
description: STATE (contract §7.2): the one page that says where a project stands, rewritten (never appended) whenever that changes. Lives at .bonsai/STATE.md in every project; the body is free, and this schema describes its YAML frontmatter as a reader returns it (JSON). Written by agents (an orchestrator rewrites it); read by every new session first, people and the studio. A writer writes every field below, in this order (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null and keeps an unknown one. The frontmatter follows the format-1 YAML rules (contract §2.4).

format.description: The version line, always the first key (contract §2.2). In a file made from a template it carries a one-line pointer back as a trailing comment (contract §2.8).

updated.description: The day the page was last rewritten, YYYY-MM-DD as text (contract §2.4).

labels.description: A map of label name to value (contract §5), for example workflow.milestone; {} when none. Names are <namespace>.<name> with one dot.
